objective: Allow a dedicated browser visual-audit surface to render the real current Ron System snapshot without a bearer token while preserving normal authenticated behavior and all mutation gates.

roles_before.artifact: The canonical PWA uses the existing device-session/bearer flow for normal access.
The normal API snapshot route is authenticated.
All System mutations remain behind the existing authenticated action/session gates.
The pre-change runtime remains recoverable from base SHA 1cd1464504bab18791c4829b0ec675741cee1a21 and Git history.

role_dispositions.destination: The root PWA and its existing session flow remain unchanged.
